questions.question: How many publicly owned buses were registered in Texas in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_vehicle_registrations_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='CY MV-1 Publish', header=None)
texas_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('^Texas', regex=True)].iloc[0]
result = int(texas_row[5])

questions.question: Which three states had the highest number of total motor vehicle registrations in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_vehicle_registrations_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='CY MV-1 Publish', header=None)
data = df.iloc[9:60].copy()
data[0] = data[0].astype(str).str.replace(r'\s*\(\d+\)', '', regex=True).str.strip()
data[15] = pd.to_numeric(data[15], errors='coerce')
top3 = data.sort_values(by=15, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].tolist()

questions.question: Between Michigan and Pennsylvania, which state had more total truck registrations in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_vehicle_registrations_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='CY MV-1 Publish', header=None)
data = df.iloc[9:60].copy()
data[0] = data[0].astype(str).str.replace(r'\s*\(\d+\)', '', regex=True).str.strip()
mi_trucks = float(data[data[0] == 'Michigan'][9].values[0])
pa_trucks = float(data[data[0] == 'Pennsylvania'][9].values[0])
result = 'Pennsylvania' if pa_trucks > mi_trucks else 'Michigan'

questions.question: What was the total number of registered motorcycles across the six New England states (Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, and Vermont) in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_vehicle_registrations_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='CY MV-1 Publish', header=None)
data = df.iloc[9:60].copy()
data[0] = data[0].astype(str).str.replace(r'\s*\(\d+\)', '', regex=True).str.strip()
ne_states = ['Connecticut', 'Maine', 'Massachusetts', 'New Hampshire', 'Rhode Island', 'Vermont']
ne_data = data[data[0].isin(ne_states)]
result = int(pd.to_numeric(ne_data[12]).sum())
